verdict.rationale: OneDrive is driven through the well-documented Microsoft Graph API, with first-party docs covering CRUD on driveItems, upload sessions for large files, delta query/change notifications for sync, search, versioning, thumbnails, and sharing links — a comprehensive, stable public API surface suitable for programmatic/agentic use. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probes returned 404s) and independent/hands-on confirmation of AI agents actually driving OneDrive via this API.
